task.claim: [Literature summary case] Expressed on all cultured/isolated haematopoietic cells; used as the gating marker.

axes.question: On the all axis, does the in-vitro finding for PTPRC (CD45) — pan-leukocyte identity marker persist? Answer from the supplied summaries.

task.instruction: Answer each axis in task.axes separately with a verdict, the observation_ids / reference keys it rests on, and the contrast-alignment basis. Then give an overall verdict consistent with the axes. Use only the provided datasets and evidence package, plus the listed tools under the stated retry policy. Report how you interpreted every non-ok reference-source status. Call submit_answer once.
checklist: Read the in-vitro origin observation and note gene, endpoint, contrast, direction.
For each axis, read the counterpart observation(s); if a required dataset is `unavailable`, apply the retry policy (fetch_dataset once) before deciding the axis.
For each axis, state the contrast alignment basis explicitly; if none can be stated, the axis is not_assessable.
For the within-person axis, verify participant_id overlap between the two patient datasets; specimen_id and timepoint are not participant identity.

Interpret reference-source statuses structurally: not_found = database has no record; error = technical, retryable; skipped = disabled by mode or upstream. Never read any of them as a biological negative.
Use GTEx reference abundance, orthology and IMPC phenotypes as background only; they are not disease-contrast observations and do not decide an axis.
Cite every observation_id or reference key an axis verdict rests on; do not cite what you did not use.
Overall verdict must be consistent with the axes: any axis diverges → overall cannot be persists; an axis not_assessable → say so in caveats.

tools.retry_policy: If a dataset marked required has status `unavailable`, call fetch_dataset(dataset_id) exactly once. If a reference source in the evidence package has status `error`, you may call build_evidence_package once. `not_found` and `skipped` do not change on retry.
